name: confetti
goal: Prepare two independent terminal notes and complete only after both have accepted evidence.

specification.goal: Prepare two independent terminal notes and complete only after both have accepted evidence.

functional_requirements.description: The left reviewer leaves a distinct observation.
The right reviewer leaves a distinct observation.

nfrs.description: Each terminal review has its own accepted evidence and check.
acceptance: left and right check artifacts are separate and both pass

argv: from pathlib import Path; Path('brief.txt').write_text('Review the launch note.\n')

done_when: brief.txt contains the shared review brief
contract.shared_reason: The same accepted brief is the prerequisite for both independent reviews.

steps.prompt: Read brief.txt. Write left-note.txt beginning with `LEFT:` and summarize one useful observation.

ready_when: the accepted review brief is available
done_when: left-note.txt contains one left reviewer observation

steps.prompt: Read brief.txt. Write right-note.txt beginning with `RIGHT:` and summarize one independent observation.

ready_when: the accepted review brief is available
done_when: right-note.txt contains one right reviewer observation
